title: Lista de habilidades: hacia arriba y en ventana
description: The skill sheet (src/battle-ui.ts `fitSkills`, `keepInView`): it slides out of Habilidad and grows upwards from the command's bottom edge, over the scene, so the dock never moves. With more skills than fit (Papagato at level 3 has six) it shows four at a time; walking past the last in sight slides the list on a row, smoothly, keeping one more in sight while there are more, and the hidden ones wait faded at the edges under ▲ / ▼ with how many; a rail by the sheet's thick edge has a segment per skill, the ones in sight lit, sliding with the list. No scrollbar: arrows, the D-pad, the wheel and the number keys move through it.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]'); window.dockTop = () => Math.round(document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"] .party-card').getBoundingClientRect().top);
